data.name: Nicolais
data.gender_notes: Nicolais is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Nikolaos, meaning 'victory of the people'. This name was popular in the early Christian church, especially among those who were victorious in their faith. The name Nicolais carries the meaning “Victory of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nicolais usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes triumph and resilience in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Nicolais belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory of the people.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nicolais total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
